description: express.urlencoded() and express.json() no longer use body-parser implicitly — configure explicitly
Router.param() callback signature changed — (req, res, next, value, name) instead of (req, res, next, id)
express.static() etag option now defaults to true — verify caching behaviour in tests
res.jsonp() no longer accepts arbitrary callback names by default — must configure jsonp callback name
app.router is removed — mount routers using app.use(router) explicitly
